Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(OrderProduct) = OrderProduct.allInstance()
	precondition:
		orderid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		let ob: OrderProduct in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		ob.Id = orderid and
		ob.Time = now() and
		ob.OrderStatus = NEW and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		result = true
}
